title: First Unique Character
summary: Return the index of the first character that appears exactly once in a string.

tests.explain: s appears three times. w (index 1) and i (index 2) appear once each, and w comes first.
Every character repeats, so there is no unique one.
l and e each appear twice; v at index 2 is the only character that appears once.

hints: Checking every character against every other character is O(n²). What could you compute once, up front?
Make one pass that counts how many times each character appears.
Then make a second pass over s in its original order and return the first index whose count is 1. Return -1 if none is.

complexity.time: O(n): two passes over the string
